required_validator_contracts: A composite operand containing border/superior border/inferior border/midpoint/anterior border/posterior border/end/apex or equivalent subfeature cannot be RESOLVED solely by the parent whole-entity mesh.
If a relation uses a composite landmark with an extracted child subfeature, the executable dependency chain must bind and use that child subfeature or remain UNRESOLVED.
Pose/body-position conditions incompatible with default atlas pose must remain CONDITIONAL.
note: Automated identity/structural validation remains valid for artifact consistency, but is insufficient for semantic-granularity preservation.
